title: Counting the steps
description:
Count how many steps three loops take and watch them grow.

```
     n    linear   nested     halving
    10        10      100           3
   100       100    10000           6
  1000      1000  1000000           9
```
hints: Count with a variable you increase inside the innermost loop body (lesson 1.01).
requirements: Three functions that return a step count: a single loop to `n`, two nested loops to `n`, and a loop that halves `n` until it reaches 1.
Print a table for n = 10, 100 and 1000 with `std::setw`.
Say in a comment which is O(n), O(n²) and O(log n).
stretch: Time each one with `std::chrono` for bigger n and compare the times with the counts.
